mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation index above 240 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to market concerns over rising prices eroding equity valuations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 240 or 20-day forward returns are positive despite the inflation spike (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on asset prices, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases 2% and INDPRO decreases 1% in the same month
failure_condition: The GDPC1-INDPRO combination does not occur or 5-day returns are negative despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE < 4%), falling FEDFUNDS rates amplify market optimism, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The regime conditions are not met or 60-day returns are negative despite the low rates and unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS) and rising overall demand (GDPC1) signal robust economic growth, prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases 1% and GDPC1 increases 2% in the same month
failure_condition: The PAYEMS-GDPC1 combination does not occur or 20-day returns are negative despite the positive signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 100 indicates weakening supply-side pressures, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross below 100 or 5-day returns are positive despite the drop.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in UNRATE (rising unemployment) indicates weakening labor market conditions, prompting negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline sufficiently or 20-day returns are positive despite the rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (tightening) and CPIAUCSL (inflation) creates policy uncertainty, driving negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases 0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL combination does not occur or 5-day returns are positive despite the conflicting signals.
